Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) vs International School of Management (ISM) is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) vs International School of Management (ISM) for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) if you want a recorded fee of ₹14,500, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Patna.
Choose International School of Management (ISM) if you want a 2024 flagship package record of ₹6 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹4 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Patna.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹14,500 as a tuition figure for MBA at Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI). Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹4 lakh as a programme total for Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM at International School of Management (ISM).

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

International School of Management (ISM)'s latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹6 LPA and a highest package of ₹18.5 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.

International School of Management (ISM) is listed on our records with CAT, XAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Bihar. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI)'s recorded ₹14,500 or International School of Management (ISM)'s ₹4 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.

If you want a documented flagship placement year, International School of Management (ISM) is the clearer record here, because Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) or International School of Management (ISM)?

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) vs International School of Management (ISM)?

faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Dr Zakir Husain Institute (ZHI) here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
